notes:
Snapshot from calls + POC notes:
- Product: IDE copilot that can run tests, lint, and stream build logs inside a locked sandboxed runner. Core promise: ‘run with zero-risk code execution’ — customers want hermetic execution plus function/tool calling API so assistant can invoke test/lint/build agents directly.
- Customer quote (CTO): "We need the copilot to run our test suites and return structured failures, but we cannot allow network egress or artifact upload outside our control."
- Key technical asks: low-latency streaming for incremental test output, model pinning per workspace, deterministic tool-call API for running unit tests, KV cache for large multi-file contexts, and audit trail for all agent-invoked commands.
- Desired flow: user in VSCode triggers assistant -> assistant calls redwood function to spawn ephemeral sandbox -> sandbox runs tests/linter -> streaming logs to editor; assistant posts summarized failure and suggestion. Also ability to re-run specific failing test via function call.
- Cost profile: willing to pay premium for private/dedicated because of strict isolation and predictable SLA. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching test invocations across developer fleets.
- Security: mandatory SSO/SAML, KMS for secrets, retention controls for logs, ISO27001 required for enterprise pilot. On-prem package desired for initial rollout.
- Sales notes: AE introduced 2026-01-20 via inbound trial. Technical discovery 2026-02-10 with SE present. POC kickoff 2026-03-02 (Fireflies link). Demo scheduled 2026-03-17; need SE lab image and sample runner.
- Risk/Objections: legal will request full threat model and attacker surface for sandbox; engineering wants deterministic reproducibility across local and CI runners.
- Next immediate action: SE to deliver prototype runner image and a sample function-calling manifest (endpoints + schemas) by 2026-03-14.
- Short choppy CRM-style lines seen in call notes: "need streaming logs trimmed", "pin model to v1.4.2 for deterministic suggestions", "no internet egress allowed from runner".
